parameters.box: Integer-grid premultiplied-alpha BOX in encoded sRGB. Alpha=round-half-up(sum(a)/16); RGB=round-half-up(sum(rgb*a)/sum(a)); alpha0=>RGBA0.
parameters.geometry: Whole-canvas fixed translation and uniform quarter scale. No crop-fit, pose shift, head lock, redraw, interpolation, shadow removal or sharpening.
parameters.paletteFit: All original timeline ticks across all four looks, alpha>=128 for training only; output alpha is unthresholded.
parameters.transitionMetadata: Entire original derivation and sourceMetadata preserved verbatim; sourcePixelFull added alongside motionFlow.
